items.title: Haluatko tietää sohvalta nousematta, kuka pimputtaa ovikelloa? Näillä laitteilla se onnistuu

items.title: NGINX Fixes 5 Flaws, Including Possible RCE and a TLS Bug That May Skip Client-Cert Checks
items.summary: NGINX released versions 1.30.6 and 1.31.7 on October 14 to fix five vulnerabilities, one of them present in every release since May 2005. There are three memory bugs that F5, the company behind NGINX, says could crash a worker process or possibly let an attacker run code, and each requires a specific configuration to exploit. A fourth lets an attacker forge a TLS session that could get past client-certificate checks, though F5 calls the forgery non-deterministic and beyond the attacker's control. The fifth lets an HTTP/3 client slip extra bytes into a request that NGINX passes on to a backend.…

Several exploit paths exist through contributed modules, and at least one known path needs no login. Viime vuonna lihavuuslääkkeitä osti vajaat 108 000 henkilöä, mikä on peräti 43 prosenttia enemmän kuin toissa vuonna.
